test_inputs.label: ЦРЦТ demo meeting transcript (Russian) — regenerate if missing

assertions.description: Report is written in Russian (matches transcript language)
assertions.source_rule: Write in the language of the transcript — Russian transcript = Russian report

assertions.description: Core Jobs include success criteria (not a criteria-less job-story)
assertions.source_rule: A Job is 'I want to {outcome} with {success criteria}'. Criteria are mandatory — without them the Job can't be coverage-judged or designed against.

assertions.description: Each Job ladders to a Big Job (motivational parent), not a flat feature-level verb
assertions.source_rule: Ladder to the Big Job — the motivational level above the Core Job. Orphan pain → raise the Job.

assertions.description: Every pain is classified into a canon type (Problem / Barrier / Tax Job / emotion / fear)
assertions.source_rule: Classify every pain — the fix depends on the class (Problem→value/chain; Barrier→reality; Tax Job→kill; emotion→remove; fear→verify).

assertions.description: Contains verbatim customer quotes with speaker/timestamp attribution
assertions.source_rule: Quote verbatim — exact customer words, with speaker and timestamp
Map decision dynamics: Champion / Blocker / Neutral / User for each participant

assertions.description: Current Chain section present (how the customer walks the Big Job today, Tax Jobs marked)
assertions.source_rule: Reconstruct the Current Chain; mark Tax Jobs. Mark [INSUFFICIENT DATA] if a demo doesn't supply it — don't skip silently.

assertions.description: Gap map present with typed gaps (Core-Job / Barrier / chain-break / value)
assertions.source_rule: Type every gap — the class sets the fix and effort. Core-Job gap→build; Barrier→reality; chain-break→repair; value→raise to criteria.

assertions.description: Per-finding confidence tags present (observed / inferred / hypothesis)
assertions.source_rule: Tag confidence on every Job/pain/gap — the downstream gap-analysis uses tags to decide what needs a depth-interview.

assertions.description: Competitive context / Consideration Set captured (what the customer compares at choice)
assertions.source_rule: Map competitive context = Consideration Set evidence: why mentioned, strengths, gaps, who brought it up.

assertions.description: Pains are linked to Jobs by ID (not standalone)
assertions.source_rule: Pains link to Jobs (J1, J2…); the two halves of the report share Job IDs — nothing is duplicated.

assertions.description: Deal viability score present with /12 total (deal, not product)
assertions.source_rule: Score deal viability X/12 (template §12) — a deal-opportunity score, explicitly NOT a product go/no-go.
Don't guess — mark ambiguity as [AMBIGUOUS]; distinguish observed vs inferred.

assertions.description: Misalignment section present with concrete entries (where the team misread the customer)
assertions.source_rule: Misalignment Detection — often the most valuable sales finding. Flag every instance with consequences.

assertions.description: Next steps are specific — priority marker AND owner/deadline
assertions.source_rule: Each next step: priority, action, effort, owner, target date. No generic advice.

assertions.description: Epistemic humility — report flags thin-data findings (hypothesis / needs depth-interview), does not assert as settled
assertions.source_rule: A single demo is weak evidence; don't assert structural findings as settled. Flag what needs depth-interview (Т-плюс lesson).
